notes.title: Demo patch 0.1.10
notes.content:
[b]Demo patch note 0.1.10[/b]
[list]
[*]General gamepad support in game and in menus.
[*]Added a bruteforce protection for keypad. Now you will need to actually try to solve the puzzles ːsunglassesDogeː
[*]Fixed a bug where the assistant would restart her dialogue sometimes.
[*]Fixed bugs related to text tutorials. The text shouldn't be cut anymore in the french version.
[*]Added a setting to keep the sound from playing when alt tabbing. Useful for streamers!
[*]Added a setting to invert the look axis. 
[*]Added a setting to change the mouse sensitivity when drawing. So you can be the best artist out there!
[*]The puzzles "Three Little Pigs" and "Just grab the key" have been reworked as they were a little bit confusing.
[*]Tutorial have been made a littler clearer in the museum.
[*]Symbols won't spawn in walls anymore. It was sometimes a little bit annoying to see lightning stuck in a wall.
[*]Reworked the first meeting with the painter so that reading the code is easier to understand.
[*]Made the maps smaller. Walking around shouldn't be too annoying anymore ːsunglassesDogeː
[*]Fixed a bug where the cursor would move to the top left corner when opening the setting menu.
[*]Fixed the noclip cheat, this should now disable gravity. You can now cheat with class ːsunglassesDogeː
[/list]

notes.title: Demo patch 0.1.7 : Hotfixes
notes.content:
[b]Changelog[/b]
[list]
[*] The flying mechanic in houses with balloons now feels more natural
[*] Fixed issue where drawing would cause the player to fall off flying houses
[*] Balloons are now properly destroyed
[*] Fixed sound issue with lightbulb activation on game load
[*] Inactive paintings can now be activated by drawing on them
[*] Fixed issue where the hot air balloon was not properly saved, which caused players to get stuck in the lighthouse
[*] Slightly modified some painting angles to make it easier to draw on them
[*] Fixed bug introduced in the last patch that allowed drawing during the end-of-demo message
[/list]

notes.title: Update 0.1.4 : Hotfix and QoL improvements
notes.content:
Update 0.1.4 changelog
[list]
[*] Reduced the volume of the lightning symbol's sound.
[*] It is now easier to see what observers are looking at ( you know, the weird shirtless guys with a big eye).
[*] Fixed a bug where the drawn symbol wouldn't appear at the right location. 
[*] Improved the quality of symbol recognition. It should be more precise now.
[*] Fixed a bug where players could move the head and draw during some loading screens.
[*] Other minor things.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 0.1.2 : Hotfixes
notes.content:
A new patch has been released for the demo.

Changelog:
- Some doors were not saved properly and it was possible to be stuck in the puzzle called "The Great Escape" if you left the game or tried to come back to that level.
- Added accessibility to cheats in the main menu. If you get stuck, you can unlock them and use the noclip
